architecture: Current working-tree contracts; not deployment attestation

channels.name: Native callbacks / MCP
channels.authentication: Client invocation/approval; no independent device attestation
channels.limitations: Only received callbacks or BAP tool calls are covered

channels.name: Lifecycle and evidence upload
channels.authentication: Enrolled bearer proof and session ownership
channels.encryption: Verified non-loopback HTTPS; edge TLS minimum 1.2
channels.limitations: Retain supported retry evidence; public health does not prove reporting identity

channels.name: Signed policy polling
channels.authentication: Enrolled credential, pinned asset-bound Ed25519 bundle, current-source nonce proof
channels.encryption: TLS transport; cache signatures are not encryption
channels.limitations: Valid cache subject to signed lease; three-second polling is not a delivery SLA
channels.status: implemented in working tree; matching rollout required

channels.name: Resource grant consumption
channels.authentication: Bounded signed grant and configured central consumption
channels.limitations: Central consumption must be enabled/reachable; distributed usage state unqualified

channels.name: Enrollment and IdP login
channels.destination: Configured identity provider and enrollment API
channels.authentication: Actual configured IdP or approved enrollment proof
channels.limitations: Real account-owner authentication may be required; simulated flows are distinct

channels.name: Protected backend request
channels.authentication: Checked grant and adapter-specific backend identity
channels.limitations: Only protected routes are governed; admission is not backend completion

channels.name: Local process execution
channels.protocol: OS process APIs and optional native-runner relay
channels.limitations: Windows native tests exist; legacy path and other platforms have different limits

channels.name: Administrative cockpit
channels.protocol: Configured HTTPS API / browser origin checks
channels.encryption: Configured HTTPS; no universal TLS 1.3 guarantee
channels.limitations: Individual admin SSO deferred; published freezes are not immediate all-host termination
